trial_title: A Study to Evaluate the Efficacy of Bevacizumab Plus Irinotecan in Recurrent Gliomas
brief_summary: To assess the efficacy and safety of bevacizumab plus irinotecan for the patients with recurrent anaplastic astrocytoma or with recurrent glioblastoma multiforme

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically diagnosed recurrent anaplastic astrocytoma or recurrent glioblastoma multiforme
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a histologically diagnosed anaplastic astrocytoma.

eligibility_table.criterion: Performance status of 0 and 1 on the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) criteria
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have an ECOG performance status score of 0 or 1?

eligibility_table.justification: No information on measurable disease is provided in the profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have at least one measurable lesion as defined by the Response Assessment in Neuro-Oncology (RANO) criteria?

eligibility_table.criterion: Adequate hematologic (neutrophil count >= 1500/uL, platelets >= 100,000/uL), hepatic (transaminase <= upper normal limit (UNL)x2.5, bilirubin level <= UNLx1.5, alkaline phosphatase <= UNLx2.5), and renal (creatinine clearance >= 30mL/min)
eligibility_table.justification: Lab values are not provided to assess hematologic, hepatic, and renal function.

eligibility_table.criterion: Expected life time more than at least 2 months
eligibility_table.justification: The patient is 45 years old and likely has an expected lifetime of more than 2 months.

eligibility_table.criterion: A patients who signed the informed consent prior to the participation in the study
eligibility_table.justification: No information on whether the patient has signed informed consent is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient signed the informed consent form prior to the initiation of the study?

eligibility_table.justification: The patient is male and therefore not pregnant or lactating.

eligibility_table.criterion: A patient of childbearing potential without being tested for pregnancy at baseline or with a positive test. (A premenopausal woman with the amenorrhea period of at least 12 months or longer is considered to have non-childbearing potential.)
eligibility_table.justification: No information on childbearing potential or pregnancy testing is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been tested for pregnancy at baseline, and if so, was the result negative?

eligibility_table.criterion: A man or woman of childbearing potential without the willingness to use a contraceptive measures during the study
eligibility_table.justification: No information on willingness to use contraceptive measures is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Is the patient willing to use contraceptive measures during the study?

eligibility_table.criterion: A patient with history of another malignant disease within past 3 years, except curatively treated basal cell carcinoma of the skin, cervical carcinoma in situ, and early gastric cancer
eligibility_table.justification: No information on history of another malignant disease is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient been diagnosed with any malignant disease other than curatively treated basal cell carcinoma of the skin, cervical carcinoma in situ, or early gastric cancer within the past 3 years?

eligibility_table.criterion: Medically uncontrolled serious heart, lung, neurological, psychological, or metabolic disease
eligibility_table.justification: No information on the control of serious heart, lung, neurological, psychological, or metabolic diseases is provided.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a New York Heart Association (NYHA) classification of ≥ Class III heart failure, or a forced expiratory volume in 1 second (FEV1) < 50% of predicted, or a neurological condition that significantly impairs daily functioning?

eligibility_table.justification: No information is provided regarding the presence of uncontrolled serious infections.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient experienced any uncontrolled serious infections requiring hospitalization or intravenous antibiotics in the past 30 days?

eligibility_table.criterion: Enrollment in other study within 30 days
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information about whether the patient is currently enrolled in another study.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Has the patient enrolled in any other clinical study within the last 30 days?

eligibility_table.justification: There is no information regarding any hemorrhage on baseline radiologic examination.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the baseline radiologic examination show any evidence of hemorrhage in the brain or spinal region?

eligibility_table.criterion: A patient who refused to sign the informed consent
eligibility_table.justification: There is no information about whether the patient has refused to sign the informed consent.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Did the patient explicitly refuse to sign the informed consent form for participation in the study?
